summary: Tested the new 360° persona-building quiz (backend) and Profile tab crash-fix (frontend). 7/7 backend pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_tina_360.py: transition message, free-text mid-quiz re-prompt, 8 sequential chip answers → archetype_reveal with public-safe fields only, tina_profiles upsert via GET /api/tina/360/profile/{user_id}, /api/tina/360/questions returns 8 questions + dynamic genres + tropes, and /api/matches regression. CRITICAL invariant verified: personality_vector and raw scores NEVER leak in any response (deep JSON walk for forbidden keys). Frontend Profile tab loads cleanly with topMovies=null — Array.isArray guard at profile.tsx:1372 holds; no red screen. Code review of TinaChatScreen.tsx confirms p360Chip rendering, archetypeReveal modal, and sendToTina forwarding selected_360_option to backend. Note: deprecated shadow* / pointerEvents style props warnings exist (non-blocking).

issues: RN web warns 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — should migrate to boxShadow. Also 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated, use style.pointerEvents. useNativeDriver not supported on web (expected, non-blocking).

action_items: Optional: replace shadow* style props with boxShadow across the RN codebase (web deprecation warnings only).
critical_code_review_comments: tina_service._handle_360_turn correctly de-dupes by question_id before appending, so repeat taps on the same question don't double-advance — verified by test design.
server.py:3460-3468 (GET /api/tina/360/profile/{user_id}) explicitly whitelists fields returned — personality_vector intentionally NOT in the response. ✅
server.py:3435-3442 (POST /api/tina/360/submit) returns only archetype/intent/primary_love_language/reveal_message — no raw scores. ✅
matchmaking_service.py:1988-1995 injects 360 archetype/intent/love_language/trope into the AI prompt as instructed.
profile.tsx:1372 uses Array.isArray guard on topMovies — confirmed not to crash when topMovies=null.
TinaChatScreen.tsx renders mode='personality_360' chips with p360Chip style + archetypeReveal modal. sendToTina forwards selected_360_option.
tina_personality.py: 12 hidden dimensions + 8 questions are well-encapsulated; hidden vector stays server-side.

success_rate.frontend: Profile crash-fix verified; full Tina 360 UI E2E gated by onboarding so code-reviewed only

seed_data_creation: None persisted; pytest uses ephemeral TEST_360_<uuid> user_ids and TEST_UNKNOWN_<uuid>. Personality docs are upserted under those ids in tina_profiles.

If main agent updates question order or option keys, update QUIZ_ANSWERS in the test.
